title: Start using the tvbuff_snappy routines in Couchbase and Kafka.
description:
This merge request includes some minor cleanups of the tvbuff_snappy routines, and then puts those routines into use for decompressing Snappy-compressed data in the Couchbase and Kafka dissectors.

I have not been able to locate any capture files containing Snappy-compressed data in Couchbase or Kafka conversations, so I have just tried to be careful...

notes.body: Hi #couchbase guy, do you have some Couchbase with Snappy pcap ? @jim_couchbase @daverigby @trond.norbye @ben.huddleston
I sent an old kafka capture with Snappy in it to Darius privately (as I don't remember if I made it or someone gave it to me).
